title: EPRO: Robust Policy Optimization Through an Imperfect Execution-Policy Predictor
abstract: arXiv:2611.32810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: RL for LLMs often separates rollout generation from policy training. Although the two numerical engines share model parameters, they can induce different policies. This creates a challenge beyond correcting a known training-inference mismatch: during learner updates, the execution policy corresponding to the current parameters cannot be directly observed. We view this as optimizing an unobserved execution policy through an imperfect predictor of its evolution. This perspective raises two fundamental questions: how can we estimate the execution policy's response to learner updates, and how much should we trust that estimate when optimizing the actual execution policy? We introduce Execution-Policy Robust Optimization (EPRO) to address these challenges. translated_title: EPRO：通过不完美的执行策略预测器实现鲁棒策略优化
translated_abstract: 针对大语言模型的强化学习（RL）通常将 rollout 生成与策略训练分离。尽管这两个数值引擎共享模型参数，它们却可能诱导出不同的策略。这带来了一个超出修正已知训练-推理不匹配范畴的挑战：在学习器更新期间，与当前参数相对应的执行策略无法被直接观测到。我们将此问题视为通过一个对其演化的不完美预测器来优化一个不可观测的执行策略。这一视角引出了两个根本性问题：我们如何估计执行策略对学习器更新的响应，以及在优化实际执行策略时我们应该在多大程度上信任该估计？我们提出了执行策略鲁棒优化（EPRO）来应对这些挑战。从观测到的 rollout 时执行策略出发，我们利用训练策略的变化来构建当前执行策略的可微分预测器，其分数可产生 Transpor（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: EPRO 针对大语言模型强化学习中训练与 rollout 执行策略不一致且当前执行策略不可直接观测的问题，利用训练策略变化构建可微分的执行策略预测器，并在信任度约束下对实际执行策略进行鲁棒优化。
en_tdlr: EPRO tackles the unobservable execution policy in RL for LLMs by constructing a differentiable predictor of the execution policy from training-policy changes and robustly optimizing the actual execution policy with controlled trust in that estimate.
